narrative.overview: A calm shared workspace with the warmth of a daily journal and the clarity of a task app. Paper-like surfaces and a quiet serif heading give the app a human character; familiar controls and compact list rows keep attention on the work.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutrals and restrained status colors.
Serif headings paired with readable sans-serif controls and task text.
One shared list, with clear filters and direct status selection.
Mobile-first spacing, visible focus, and honest synchronization feedback.
dos: Do keep actions familiar, labeled, and usable with keyboard and touch.
Do show authoritative save and synchronization feedback in Spanish.
Do allow long task titles and deadlines to wrap.
donts: Don't rely on color alone to convey status or errors.
Don't introduce decorative paper textures that compete with the task list.
